content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a digital store using blockchain technology and free tools that empower Ethiopian creators. By deploying a sovereign commerce stack, you can accept payments in USDT on the Tron network, which settles transactions in under 60 seconds for a minimal fee of less than $0.10. This infrastructure eliminates reliance on traditional banking and allows you to sell digital products directly to your audience.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

To get started, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack for $97. This package includes hosting on GitHub Pages and backend logic through Google Apps Script, allowing you to load three products. Integrating NOWPayments will enable seamless crypto transactions, ensuring you keep full ownership of your data without ongoing fees or subscriptions. This stack provides the essential tools needed to kickstart your digital product sales.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages both provide free static site hosting that works identically regardless of where the store operator is located. A store deployed on Cloudflare Pages by a creator in Harare is served from Cloudflare's global edge network — the same infrastructure that serves enterprises in New York. Neither platform imposes geographic restrictions on who can deploy a store or who can access it. Combined with NOWPayments for payment processing and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, this creates a complete commerce infrastructure with zero hosting costs and no geographic restrictions at any layer of the stack.
Seamless crypto payments are now within reach for Ethiopian creators.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. A seller in Addis Ababa and a seller in Amsterdam receive USDT transactions through the same NOWPayments infrastructure, at the same speed, with the same 0.5% fee. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, finalize your product listings and ensure your payment integration is functional. Promote your digital store on social media to attract your initial customers. Utilize Binance P2P for peer-to-peer transactions in naira or cedis, enhancing your payment options. With the Complete Builder Kit at $197, you’ll gain access to all blueprints and templates necessary for scaling your digital commerce stack.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Set up your digital store today and bypass traditional banking barriers.

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack for $97 to access essential tools. 2. Set up your GitHub Pages for hosting your store. 3. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 4. List your digital products and confirm their availability. 5. Perform a test transaction to ensure payment processing works smoothly. 6. Promote your store on social media channels to attract customers.
